fix.item: avatars of the content plugin are shown at imagewidth and imageheight, also when the template sets max-width or height auto on images (the padding no longer makes them 10px smaller, a non-square image is cropped instead of stretched)

addition.item: English and Dutch translations of the module, the plugin, the library and the package
the module has layouts (tmpl), also as override in the template

change.item: module, plugin and library use the structure of Joomla 5 and 6 (namespaces, service providers, events) and no longer need the Backward Compatibility plugin
the library has classes (Tazzios\Library\CbListHelper) instead of global functions
fewer database queries in the module
the package checks for Joomla 5.0 and PHP 8.1 and removes the files of older versions
